svg.title: Tessmora: Connected knowledge. Grounded answers.
svg.desc: The Tessmora wordmark and brand icon sit on the left. On the right, document, image, audio and video icons connect through violet, teal and orange paths to an answer page with citations. This is a conceptual product illustration, not a UI screenshot.
